extracted.name: California Farm Chicken Leg Quarter Stew
extracted.description: Yes, this meal is tasty, hearty, and filling. It is also quick and inexpensive, a large chicken quarter feeds four, 50 cents per meal with all ingredients.
ingredient_lines: Chicken leg quarter (pound and a half)
1/2 cup all-purpose flour and 1/2 cup soft butter, kneaded together by hand
Cup quartered yellow onion, cup quartered red onion
Tbs olive oil, tsp pepper, tsp dried thyme, no salt, (already in the bacon)
Big fresh tomato, or 4 sundried tomatoes, or small can tomato paste
instruction_lines: Heat dutch oven, add Tbs olive oil, add cup chopped bacon, brown. Add 2 cups onion, 4 cloves of garlic,fry till brown. Strain, set aside. Brown chicken leg both sides with thyme and pepper, set aside. Brown mushrooms, set aside. Brown carrot slices and tomato in chicken juices, set aside.

Put cup of chicken stock, cup of wine, cup of hand kneaded soft butter and flour in pan drippings, heat, stir till thick, then add all other ingredients. Simmer till meat falls off the bone, about an hour. Remove bones, chunk the chicken meat, serve with french bread, rice, or mashed potatoes to scoop up every drop of the gravy. Enjoy.
